data: Does the probability increase faster when generating with top-k sampling than when teacher-forcing the model on human text?

Yes, the probability increases faster when generating with top-k sampling than when teacher-forcing the model on human text. The caption explicitly states this, and the graph shows that the lines for top-k sampling (turquoise and blue) rise more steeply than the red line for teacher-forcing.
